en: Remote Control: Improved fork names when the app doesn't set one: a long name keeps its "(fork)" ending, and in sessions started with `claude remote-control` a fork of "Name (fork)" is "Name (fork 2)"
zh: 远程控制：改进应用未设置名称时的 fork 命名：长名称保留“(fork)”结尾；在使用 `claude remote-control` 启动的 session 中，“Name (fork)”的 fork 为“Name (fork 2)”
